takeaways: We release both models, inference code, a demo, and VeriSpoof-Bench, the evaluation suite covering these questions.

We present VeriSpoof, an audio language model that unifies five tasks with shared weights: deepfake detection, generator attribution (generator, acoustic model and vocoder), recording-condition analysis, synthesized-span localisation, and source verification.
Each decision is supported by grounded rationales whose statements can be independently verified.
